record_title: Rank-free mixed Schatten commutator cost for finite-rank normal operators
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The rank-one constant c_{p,q} is not evaluated or claimed sharp. The infinite-rank extension requires an infinite-dimensional kernel, and no exact phase transition is claimed for trace-zero finite-rank targets. Anderson--Brown ideal-membership thresholds are prior art; the claimed contribution is the rank-free mixed Schatten factorization-cost estimate for normal targets. Salinas 1974 was inspected as nearby ideal-theoretic prior art; Anderson 1986, Indiana Univ. Math. J. 35, 373--378 (MR 833400), remains a full-text access uncertainty and could contain a differently formulated related estimate.
